name: Liquidity cliff acceptance
hypothesis: Buy only after price clears a mapped thin-liquidity region and trades persist in the next deep region.
spec: Setup: Crossing a thin zone into deeper liquidity may sustain a price move. Entry: Buy only after price clears a mapped thin-liquidity region and trades persist in the next deep region. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on reentry into the thin zone or shrinking support depth. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs executable DEX pool depth and quote history (not connected)
